statement: wiiuse uses status to probe unknown MP via A600FA/6 and handshake or remove ordinary extension at A400, resetting IR/report selection. MotionPlus enabling sends A600FE=04 or 05, waits 500 ms, and reads mapped A400FA/6 independently of unsolicited 0x20. Disabling sends A400F0=55, waits 500 ms, then requests status up to three times with extra waits. Delays are host-side waits, not physical transition timing. No F6 read.

applicability.revision: Original external MotionPlus and integrated Remote Plus distinguished where possible; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. motion_plus.c 45-104,106-235 and events.c 538-650. Source-only; all physical and proposed host experiments not run.
